database_summary: This SQLite dataset models a small retail/marketing star schema: a central sales fact (sales) with related facts (costs) linked to dimensional tables for time, product, customer, promotion, channel and country, plus supplementary customer demographics and currency exchange rates. Row counts indicate sales is the largest table (events/transactions), products and channels are small lookup/dimension tables, times is a date dimension, customers is a large slowly changing-like dimension (has eff_from/eff_to/valid), promotions is a promotion dimension, costs is a time-variant measurement (cost/price) keyed by product/time/channel/promo, supplementary_demographics is a sparse additional customer attribute table, and currency holds month/year exchange rates. Joins between facts and dimensions are supported by foreign keys but some joins (e.g., sales -> customers or sales -> promotions) can multiply or restrict rows depending on SCD/time alignment and whether multiple cost rows exist for the same keys in costs.

accepted.name: sales_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id,
  cust_id,
  time_id,
  channel_id,
  promo_id,
  quantity_sold,
  amount_sold
FROM sales
accepted.description: Normalized sales transaction rows. Use this as the canonical sales event relation with pass-through keys and measures; suitable as the starting point for aggregates, joins or time-series analysis. | Use for: Total sales or quantity by product/customer/channel/time/promotion; Join sales to dimensions for enriched reporting; Filtering cohorts of transactions (e.g., by time range or channel)

accepted.name: sales_by_day_product_channel
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  time_id,
  prod_id,
  channel_id,
  SUM(quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold,
  SUM(amount_sold) AS total_amount_sold,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM sales
GROUP BY time_id, prod_id, channel_id
accepted.description: Daily aggregated sales measures at the product x channel x day grain. Useful for time-series, trend analysis, and joining to costs/time for margin calculations. | Use for: Compute daily revenue/volume per product and channel; Join to costs to compute daily margins; Feed into moving-average or trend analyses

accepted.name: latest_customer_snapshot
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  cust_id,
  cust_first_name,
  cust_last_name,
  cust_gender,
  cust_year_of_birth,
  cust_marital_status,
  cust_street_address,
  cust_postal_code,
  cust_city,
  cust_city_id,
  cust_state_province,
  cust_state_province_id,
  country_id,
  cust_main_phone_number,
  cust_income_level,
  cust_credit_limit,
  cust_email,
  cust_total,
  cust_total_id,
  cust_src_id,
  cust_eff_from,
  cust_eff_to,
  cust_valid,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_eff_from DESC, cust_src_id DESC) AS cust_version_rank
FROM customers
accepted.description: Latest active customer record per cust_id using cust_eff_from as the version ordering. Exposes cust_valid and a rank so callers can select the latest record or top-N versions per customer. Use when customers may have multiple SCD-like rows. | Use for: Get the current/most recent customer attributes for joining to sales; Audit or report on historical customer versions; Filter active customers by cust_valid after selecting rank=1

accepted.name: product_catalog
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id,
  prod_name,
  prod_desc,
  prod_subcategory,
  prod_subcategory_id,
  prod_subcategory_desc,
  prod_category,
  prod_category_id,
  prod_category_desc,
  prod_weight_class,
  prod_unit_of_measure,
  prod_pack_size,
  supplier_id,
  prod_status,
  prod_list_price,
  prod_min_price,
  prod_total,
  prod_total_id,
  prod_src_id,
  prod_eff_from,
  prod_eff_to,
  prod_valid
FROM products
accepted.description: Canonical product dimension snapshot exposing descriptive attributes and pricing measures. Use to join product metadata to sales or cost facts. | Use for: Lookup product attributes for reporting; Join to sales/costs for price and category analysis; Filter products by prod_status or prod_valid when needed

accepted.name: costs_by_day_prod_channel_promo
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  time_id,
  prod_id,
  channel_id,
  promo_id,
  AVG(unit_cost) AS avg_unit_cost,
  AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price,
  COUNT(*) AS cost_row_count
FROM costs
GROUP BY time_id, prod_id, channel_id, promo_id
accepted.description: Costs and pricing measures at the time x product x channel x promo grain. Useful for margin analysis and joining to aggregated sales; preserves unit_cost and unit_price as measures. | Use for: Compute per-day per-product margins when joined to sales aggregates; Analyze cost or price changes over time; Detect missing cost rows for sales dates

accepted.name: sales_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.prod_id,
  s.cust_id,
  s.time_id,
  s.channel_id,
  s.promo_id,
  s.quantity_sold,
  s.amount_sold,
  t.calendar_year,
  t.calendar_month_desc,
  t.calendar_quarter_desc,
  p.prod_name,
  p.prod_category,
  p.prod_category_id,
  ch.channel_desc,
  ch.channel_class,
  promo.promo_name AS promo_name,
  promo.promo_category AS promo_category,
  c.cust_first_name,
  c.cust_last_name,
  c.cust_valid,
  c.cust_eff_from,
  c.cust_version_rank
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
LEFT JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
LEFT JOIN promotions promo ON s.promo_id = promo.promo_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM latest_customer_snapshot) c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
accepted.description: Denormalized sales events joined to time, product, channel, promotion and current customer snapshot. Useful as a wide table for reporting where analysts need dimensions inline. Does not filter to latest customer; includes cust_version_rank so callers can choose. | Use for: Wide-surface reporting and exporting (e.g., orders with product/time/customer attributes); Feed to BI tools that expect denormalized rows; Compute margins or cohort metrics after joining costs or currency

accepted.name: monthly_currency
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  country,
  year,
  month,
  to_us
FROM currency
accepted.description: Canonical monthly exchange rates to USD (to_us) keyed by year and month. Useful for currency conversion of amounts when joining by sales time dimension (calendar_year and calendar_month_number). | Use for: Convert sales amounts to USD when joined through time and country; Analyze exchange rate trends by country/month/year

accepted.name: customer_demographics
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_id,
  c.cust_first_name,
  c.cust_last_name,
  c.country_id,
  c.cust_year_of_birth,
  c.cust_gender,
  sd.education,
  sd.occupation,
  sd.household_size,
  sd.yrs_residence,
  sd.affinity_card,
  sd.cricket,
  sd.baseball,
  sd.tennis,
  sd.soccer,
  sd.golf,
  sd.unknown,
  sd.misc,
  sd.comments,
  c.cust_valid,
  c.cust_eff_from,
  c.cust_version_rank
FROM (SELECT * FROM latest_customer_snapshot) c
LEFT JOIN supplementary_demographics sd ON c.cust_id = sd.cust_id
accepted.description: Supplementary demographics joined to the latest customer snapshot. Use to enrich customers with affinity flags and demographic attributes for segmentation. | Use for: Customer segmentation using demographics and affinities; Enrich sales with demographic attributes by joining on cust_id
